title: Choosing an Evening English Course · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Mei is a 28-year-old office worker in Shanghai. She wants to improve her English for her job. Every Monday and Wednesday evening, she looks at English course websites on her phone. She usually studies at home after dinner. She is not happy with her speaking, so she wants a class with a teacher. This week, Mei is trying a new evening course at a small school near her office. The class is on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 7:00 to 8:30. There are eight students in the class. The teacher, Mr. Lee, speaks slowly and clearly. He often asks questions, and the students answer in English. Mei likes the class because she can speak a lot. Mei has a busy week. On Monday, she works late and does not go to the class. On Tuesday, she goes to the class and takes notes. On Wednesday, she reviews her notes for 20 minutes. On Thursday, she goes to the class again.
